correctness.rationale: Each subset weight equals shortest Hamiltonian path length; the sharp same-part adjacency bound and alternating construction prove its exact formula. The odd stage is the join of two simplex skeleta and the even stage is its top-skeleton truncation. Odd-stage join homotopy, integer top-boundary ranks and Hurewicz/Whitehead prove every wedge multiplicity integrally. Consecutive stages have disjoint nonzero homological degrees, proving all persistence maps zero. Independent code ran 187 Hamiltonian checks and 92 mod-two boundary tests; finite checks do not substitute for the all-size proof.
